Riley: Hi team — Pacifica onboarding kickoff scheduled Thu 11:00am PT. Agenda: intros, pilot scope, data handoff, success metrics, enablement slots. Invite sent. Please bring SSO contact and a small anonymized data export. :wave:
Ivy (Pacifica): Thanks Riley — I'll invite our infra lead (Tara) and support manager (Omar). We can provide a 200-row anonymized sample by EOD.
Diego: Question: do we want to run initial eval on Hosted or Dedicated? For speed Hosted is fine. Also what's expected traffic profile?
Riley: Start Hosted pilot. Expected ~200-600 reqs/day during validation. If steady >2500/day we'll discuss Dedicated.
Sam: I'll attach the starter checklist to the kickoff doc (link in calendar). Also flagging renewal risk medium until we hit quality baseline.
Diego: Integration checklist I'll prepare: auth, sample payloads, smoke tests, and a minimal curl example.
Ivy (Pacifica): Can you also include a quick script for token rotation? Our security team will want that.
Diego: Sure — will add rotation notes and a one-page runbook for support.
Riley: Proposed success criteria: 1) Quality: blinded eval pass rate >= 85%; 2) Stability: 7-day run with error rate <1.2%; 3) Performance: p95 latency <300ms; 4) Enablement: support session recorded and runbook live. Please comment quickly if you'd change thresholds.
Sam: Adding owners and timelines to the doc. I'll schedule weekly pilot health sync (Fri 10am PT).
OnboardBot: Calendar invite created for 1768508400 (Thu 11:00am PT) with Zoom link + agenda. :white_check_mark:
Riley: Risks: SSO delays, sample data lateness. Backup: issue a time-limited service token + synthetic payloads so integration work can proceed.
Ivy (Pacifica): We'll take the service token if SSO needs extra time. Thanks — excited to get started.
Riley: Action items: [Ivy] upload anonymized sample (EOD); [Diego] smoke test + runbook (tomorrow); [Sam] pilot dashboard + weekly cadence (today). Closing kickoff thread — drop blockers here before meeting. :thumbsup:
